clue.text: High fliers in resort stick firmly together mostly

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the final letter of the word for sticking firmly is dropped

parts.note: a spa is a health resort
to cement is to bind things fast

explanation.surface: Holidaymakers at a resort cling together like a close-knit group of high-flying achievers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High fliers' suggests ambitious achievers, but these fliers really do go high: into orbit.
explanation.definitionFit: Astronauts fly higher than anyone, so spacemen are literally high fliers rather than ambitious achievers.
